title: Collision Between Vehicle Controlled by Developmental Automated Driving System and Pedestrian, Tempe, Arizona
supports_claim: The NTSB found the 2018 Tempe crash involved an ADS test vehicle and identified operator monitoring, safety-risk assessment, oversight, and automation complacency as contributing issues.
limitations: This report analyzes one US crash and does not establish performance of any future AV system or Vietnam pilot.

title: Recall Query RQ24009: Tesla Autopilot System Driver Controls
supports_claim: NHTSA opened a recall query to evaluate remedy effectiveness after identifying post-remedy concerns and apparent driver-misuse-related crashes in its prior investigation.
limitations: An open recall query is not a final finding on every crash cause or on a different developer's system.

title: DMV Statement on Cruise LLC Suspension
supports_claim: California DMV immediately suspended Cruise deployment and driverless testing permits, citing public-safety risk and safety-information concerns.
limitations: The statement is a regulator action and does not by itself establish technical root cause or generalize to supervised pilots.

title: Cruise incident enforcement decision
supports_claim: The CPUC record describes Cruise's nationwide pause and a software remedy for post-collision response after the October 2023 incident.
limitations: The commission document concerns one company's operations and should not be treated as a universal AV safety benchmark.

title: Regulation (EU) 2024/1689: Artificial Intelligence Act
publisher: Official Journal of the European Union
supports_claim: Article 6 sets high-risk classification rules for AI systems intended as safety components of products covered by listed Union harmonisation legislation.
limitations: Applicability depends on intended purpose, product-law scope, market placement, and dates; it is not a legal opinion for this pilot.

title: Decree No. 13/2023/ND-CP on Personal Data Protection
supports_claim: Vietnam's Government published Decree 13/2023/ND-CP on personal data protection, relevant to assessing a telemetry and video-adjacent data flow.
limitations: This source alone does not determine every transport, consent, controller, or cross-border-transfer obligation for the product.

title: Artificial Intelligence Risk Management Framework (AI RMF 1.0)
publisher: National Institute of Standards and Technology
supports_claim: NIST AI RMF describes governance, mapping, measurement, and management activities for trustworthy AI risk management.
limitations: The voluntary framework is not a certification and does not prove that a control is effective.
